```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % paramEntity "<!ENTITY internalEntity 'ExpandedValue'>">
  %paramEntity;
  <!ENTITY combined "&internalEntity; and More">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining the test case with CDATA and PIs -->
  <?target data="test-processing-instruction"?>
  <child ns2:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text containing entities: &combined; and tags <foo></foo>
    ]]>
  </child>
  <ns2:child>&combined;</ns2:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (module*)>
  <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!ENTITY ent "Standard Entity">
  <?audit-log status="active"?>
]>
<system xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:m="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
  <!-- Multiple comments surrounding namespace and entity usage -->
  <!-- Second comment block -->
  <m:module>
    <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with <tag> &ent; </tag>
    ]]>
  </m:module>
</system>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % extDecl "<!ENTITY deepRef '&ref; Deep'>">
  %extDecl;
  <?xml-timestamp value="2023-10-01"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:cust="http://inventory.org/cust">
  <!-- Comprehensive integration of DOCTYPE, entity, PI, xmlns, CDATA, comment -->
  <cust:item xlink:type="simple">
    <?cust-action run="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section referencing &deepRef; inside inventory item.
    ]]>
  </cust:item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (entry+)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Value2">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?custom-pi parameter="value"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://catalog.org/meta">
  <!-- Catalog comment with entity references and CDATA -->
  <meta:entry>
    <![CDATA[
      Start CDATA &ent2; End CDATA
    ]]>
  </meta:entry>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE report [
  <!ELEMENT report (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY eA "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY eB "&eA; Beta">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY eC '&eB; Gamma'>">
  %pEnt;
  <?xml-debug level="high"?>
]>
<report xmlns="http://report.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://report.org/sub">
  <!-- Top comment for report generation -->
  <?sub:pi command="render"?>
  <sub:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Special CDATA content containing &eC; and elements <markup>
    ]]>
  </sub:section>
</report>
